blocks.text: always, usually, often ...: fe'l yonida turadigan so'zlar

93-darsda «qanday?», «qayerda?», «qachon?» degan so'zlar gap oxiriga borishini ko'rdik. Lekin bir guruh qisqa so'zlar gapning **o'rtasida**, fe'lning yonida turadi. Ular asosan «qanchalik tez-tez?» savoliga javob beradi: **always** (doim), **usually** (odatda), **often** (tez-tez, ko'pincha), **sometimes** (ba'zan), **rarely** (kamdan-kam), **never** (hech qachon). Shu o'ringa **ever**, **also**, **both**, **all** ham keladi. O'zbekchada ham bu so'zlar fe'ldan oldin turadi: «Men **doim** choy ichaman» — I **always** drink tea. Asosiy qiyinchilik — **be** va yordamchi fe'llar bilan.

Fe'l bitta so'zdan iborat bo'lsa (drink, goes, played), bu so'zlar fe'ldan **oldin** keladi: I **always** drink tea. She **often** goes to the gym. We **never** played outside. `-s` va `-ed` qo'shimchalari fe'lda qoladi: she **usually** walk**s**. Bu so'zni fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga qo'yish mumkin emas (93-dars): «I drink always tea» — xato.

items.text: We **sometimes** have lunch in the park.

blocks.text: 2-qoida: am / is / are / was / were dan keyin

**be** fe'li bilan bu so'zlar **undan keyin** keladi: I'm **always** tired. She's **never** late. They were **often** hungry. O'zbekchada «U **hech qachon** kechikmaydi» — fe'l bor, shuning uchun «She never is late» deyish oson. Lekin inglizchada «kechikmoq» — **be late**, demak qoida 2 ishlaydi: She**'s never** late.

items.text: The bus is **always** late in the morning.
My grandparents were **never** rich, but they were happy.
items.translation: Bobom bilan buvim **hech qachon** boy bo'lmagan, lekin baxtli edi.

blocks.text: Fe'l ikki yoki undan ortiq so'zdan iborat bo'lsa (will go, can swim, have seen, is working, don't like), bu so'zlar **birinchi** so'zdan keyin, ya'ni ularning **o'rtasiga** qo'yiladi: I'll **always** remember. I can **never** find my keys. I've **never** been to London. Savolda — egadan keyin: Do you **often** ...? Have you **ever** ...? (**ever** = «hech», «biror marta», faqat savol va inkorda; Present Perfect bilan — 17-dars).

items.text: You can **always** call me if you need help.
items.translation: Yordam kerak bo'lsa, menga **doim** qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz mumkin.

items.text: Have you **ever** seen snow in April?

blocks.text: O'zbekchada «hech qachon» bilan fe'l **inkorda** keladi: «hech qachon go'sht **ye-ma**-yman». Inglizchada **never** ning o'zi inkor, shuning uchun fe'l **tasdiq** shaklida qoladi: I **never** eat meat. «I don't never eat meat» — xato (ikki inkor). Boshqa so'zlar inkor bilan birga kelishi mumkin: I don't **usually** get up early (odatda erta turmayman), He doesn't **often** call (kamdan-kam qo'ng'iroq qiladi), It isn't **always** easy (har doim ham oson emas).
sometimes, usually gap boshida; also, both, all

**sometimes** va **usually** gap boshida yoki oxirida ham kela oladi: **Sometimes** I walk to work. / I walk to work **sometimes**. **always** va **never** esa gap boshiga qo'yilmaydi: «Always I get up at seven» — xato. **also** («ham»), **both** («ikkalasi ham»), **all** («hammasi») ham xuddi shu o'rinda turadi: I **also** speak French. We're **both** students. They have **all** left (→ 80, 82-darslar).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I don't never eat meat.» → **I never eat meat.**; «She never is late.» → **She's never late.**; «I drink always tea.» → **I always drink tea.**; «Always I get up at seven.» → **I always get up at seven.**; «Have you been ever to London?» → **Have you ever been to London?**; «I go often to the cinema.» → **I often go to the cinema.**
Eslab qolish: oddiy fe'ldan **oldin** (I **often** go), be dan **keyin** (I'm **often** late), ikki so'zli fe'lning **o'rtasida** (I've **often** been, I can **never** remember).
Bog'lanish: Present Simple — 5–7-darslar; Have you ever ...? — 17-dars; still / yet / already ham shu o'rinda turadi — 95-dars; fe'l + to'ldiruvchi tartibi — 93-dars.

examples.title: **always** and **usually** before the verb
examples.description: Oddiy fe'ldan oldin: I **always** have, she **usually** walks. Fe'lning `-s` qo'shimchasi o'zgarmaydi.

sentences.text: I **always** have breakfast at seven.
sentences.translation: Men **doim** soat yettida nonushta qilaman.

sentences.text: Madina **usually** walks to work, but today she took a taxi.
sentences.translation: Madina **odatda** ishga piyoda boradi, lekin bugun taksiga o'tirdi.

sentences.text: Our teacher **always** gives us homework on Fridays.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz juma kunlari **doim** uy vazifasi beradi.

sentences.text: We **usually** spend New Year with my parents in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Yangi yilni **odatda** Farg'onada ota-onam bilan kutib olamiz.

sentences.text: Grandad **always** reads the newspaper after lunch.
sentences.translation: Bobom tushlikdan keyin **doim** gazeta o'qiydi.

sentences.text: In summer the shops **usually** close at ten.
sentences.translation: Yozda do'konlar **odatda** soat o'nda yopiladi.

sentences.text: Why do you **always** forget my birthday?
sentences.translation: Nega mening tug'ilgan kunimni **doim** unutasan?

sentences.text: Tom **usually** cycles to the office, even in the rain.
sentences.translation: Tom **odatda** ofisga velosipedda boradi, hatto yomg'irda ham.

sentences.text: My mum **always** says that breakfast is the most important meal.
sentences.translation: Oyim nonushta eng muhim ovqat deb **doim** aytadi.

sentences.text: On Sundays we **usually** get up late and have a big breakfast together.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari **odatda** kech turamiz va birga to'kin nonushta qilamiz.

examples.title: **often**, **sometimes**, **rarely**, **never**
examples.description: Tez-tezlik darajalari: **often** (tez-tez), **sometimes** (ba'zan), **rarely** (kamdan-kam), **hardly ever**, **never**. Hammasi oddiy fe'ldan oldin.

sentences.text: Aziz **often** plays chess with his grandfather.
sentences.translation: Aziz bobosi bilan **tez-tez** shaxmat o'ynaydi.

sentences.text: I **sometimes** work from home on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari **ba'zan** uydan ishlayman.

sentences.text: My father **never** drinks coffee in the evening.
sentences.translation: Dadam kechqurun **hech qachon** qahva ichmaydi.

sentences.text: We **rarely** eat out because it's expensive.
sentences.translation: Biz **kamdan-kam** tashqarida ovqatlanamiz, chunki qimmat.

sentences.text: Sarah **often** visits her grandmother in Leeds.
sentences.translation: Sara Lidsdagi buvisini **tez-tez** ko'rgani boradi.

sentences.text: It **hardly ever** snows in Tashkent in March.
sentences.translation: Martda Toshkentda **deyarli hech qachon** qor yog'maydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **sometimes** forgets her keys and has to call me.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **ba'zan** kalitlarini unutib, menga qo'ng'iroq qilishga majbur bo'ladi.

sentences.text: James **never** eats meat — he's a vegetarian.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **hech qachon** go'sht yemaydi — u vegetarian.

sentences.text: Do you **often** go to the theatre? — Not very often.
sentences.translation: Teatrga **tez-tez** borasizmi? — Unchalik emas.

sentences.text: The buses **rarely** come on time in winter.
sentences.translation: Qishda avtobuslar **kamdan-kam** o'z vaqtida keladi.

examples.title: After **be**: I'm **always** busy
examples.description: am / is / are / was / were dan **keyin**: I'm **always** tired, she's **never** late. O'zbekchada «kechikmaydi» fe'l bo'lsa ham, inglizchada **be late** — demak, is dan keyin.

sentences.text: I'm **always** tired on Monday mornings.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kunlari ertalab **doim** charchagan bo'laman.

sentences.text: Bekzod is **never** late for work.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ishga **hech qachon** kechikmaydi.

sentences.text: The trains are **usually** full at eight o'clock.
sentences.translation: Soat sakkizda poyezdlar **odatda** to'la bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My grandmother is **often** at our house at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari buvim **ko'pincha** bizning uyda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: We were **always** hungry after school.
sentences.translation: Maktabdan keyin qornimiz **doim** och bo'lardi.

sentences.text: Emma is **sometimes** a bit shy with new people.
sentences.translation: Emma notanish odamlar bilan **ba'zan** biroz uyatchang bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The weather in London is **rarely** hot.
sentences.translation: Londonda havo **kamdan-kam** issiq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Are you **always** this busy, or is it just this week?
sentences.translation: Siz **doim** shunday bandmisiz yoki faqat shu haftami?

sentences.text: My brother was **never** good at maths, but he's an excellent artist.
sentences.translation: Akam matematikada **hech qachon** kuchli bo'lmagan, lekin u ajoyib rassom.

sentences.text: The museum is **usually** quiet in the morning, so let's go early.
sentences.translation: Ertalab muzey **odatda** tinch bo'ladi, shuning uchun erta boraylik.

examples.title: After auxiliaries: I can **never** remember
examples.description: Ikki so'zli fe'lda — o'rtasida: can **never** remember, have **never** been, don't **usually** watch, are **always** asking.

sentences.text: I can **never** remember her phone number.
sentences.translation: Uning telefon raqamini **hech qachon** eslay olmayman.

sentences.text: You should **always** wear a helmet on a bike.
sentences.translation: Velosipedda **doim** dubulg'a kiyish kerak.

sentences.text: I've **never** been to Scotland.
sentences.translation: Men Shotlandiyada **hech qachon** bo'lmaganman.

sentences.text: We don't **usually** watch TV in the evening.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun **odatda** televizor ko'rmaymiz.

sentences.text: She'll **always** remember her first day at school.
sentences.translation: U maktabdagi birinchi kunini **doim** eslaydi.

sentences.text: The children are **always** asking for sweets.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **doim** shirinlik so'rashadi.

sentences.text: Aziz has **often** helped me with my English.
sentences.translation: Aziz menga ingliz tilida **tez-tez** yordam bergan.

sentences.text: My parents don't **often** go out at night.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam kechqurunlari tashqariga **kamdan-kam** chiqishadi.

sentences.text: You can **sometimes** see the mountains from our balcony.
sentences.translation: Balkonimizdan **ba'zan** tog'larni ko'rish mumkin.

sentences.text: Tom doesn't **always** answer his phone, so send him a message.
sentences.translation: Tom telefoniga **har doim ham** javob beravermaydi, shuning uchun unga xabar yozing.

examples.title: Questions: Do you **often** ...? Have you **ever** ...?
examples.description: Savolda — egadan keyin: Do you **often** ...? Is she **always** ...? Have you **ever** ...? Savol → qisqa javob.

sentences.text: Do you **often** cook at home? — Yes, almost every day.
sentences.translation: Uyda **tez-tez** ovqat pishirasizmi? — Ha, deyarli har kuni.

sentences.text: Have you **ever** been to Samarkand? — Yes, twice.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **hech** bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, ikki marta.

sentences.text: Is Madina **always** so quiet? — No, she's just tired today.
sentences.translation: Madina **doim** shunaqa jimmi? — Yo'q, bugun shunchaki charchagan.

sentences.text: Does your brother **usually** drive to work? — No, he takes the metro.
sentences.translation: Akangiz ishga **odatda** mashinada boradimi? — Yo'q, metroda boradi.

sentences.text: What do you **usually** have for breakfast? — Bread, cheese and tea.
sentences.translation: Nonushtaga **odatda** nima yeysiz? — Non, pishloq va choy.

sentences.text: Are you **ever** late for work? — Never! I leave home early.
sentences.translation: Ishga **hech** kechikasizmi? — Hech qachon! Uydan erta chiqaman.

sentences.text: **How often** do you see your cousins? — Not often, maybe twice a year.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchalaringizni **qanchalik tez-tez** ko'rasiz? — Ko'p emas, yiliga ikki martadir.

sentences.text: Can you **always** understand British people? — Not always!
sentences.translation: Britaniyaliklarni **doim** tushuna olasizmi? — Har doim ham emas!

sentences.text: Did you **often** play outside when you were a child? — Yes, all day!
sentences.translation: Bolaligingizda tashqarida **tez-tez** o'ynarmidingiz? — Ha, kun bo'yi!

sentences.text: Has James **ever** tried Uzbek plov? — No, never, but he wants to.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **hech** o'zbek palovini tatib ko'rganmi? — Yo'q, hech qachon, lekin juda xohlaydi.

examples.title: **never** + positive verb; don't **usually**
examples.description: O'zbekchada «hech qachon» + inkor fe'l (yemayman), inglizchada **never** + tasdiq fe'l (I never eat). Boshqa so'zlar inkor bilan: don't **usually**, isn't **always**.

sentences.text: I **never** eat fast food.
sentences.translation: Men **hech qachon** fast-fud **yemayman**.

sentences.text: Lola **never** watches horror films; she gets scared.
sentences.translation: Lola qo'rqinchli filmlarni **hech qachon** **ko'rmaydi**, qo'rqib ketadi.

sentences.text: We **never** went abroad when I was a child.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda biz chet elga **hech qachon** **bormaganmiz**.

sentences.text: My dog **never** barks at children.
sentences.translation: Itim bolalarga **hech qachon** **hurmaydi**.

sentences.text: I don't **usually** get up before eight, but today I had an exam.
sentences.translation: **Odatda** soat sakkizdan oldin **turmayman**, lekin bugun imtihonim bor edi.

sentences.text: Aziz isn't **always** right, but he **never** admits it.
sentences.translation: Aziz **har doim ham** haq bo'lavermaydi, lekin buni **hech qachon** tan **olmaydi**.

sentences.text: The baby **hardly ever** cries at night.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq kechasi **deyarli hech qachon** **yig'lamaydi**.

sentences.text: Tom doesn't **often** call me, but he **always** sends a card on my birthday.
sentences.translation: Tom menga **kamdan-kam** qo'ng'iroq qiladi, lekin tug'ilgan kunimda **doim** tabriknoma yuboradi.

sentences.text: Sarah has **never** missed a lesson this year.
sentences.translation: Sara bu yil **birorta ham** darsni **qoldirmagan**.

sentences.text: My grandparents **never** use a computer — they prefer to write letters.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim **hech qachon** kompyuterdan **foydalanmaydi** — xat yozishni afzal ko'rishadi.

examples.title: **also**, **both**, **all** in the middle
examples.description: **also** (ham), **both** (ikkalasi ham), **all** (hammasi) — xuddi always kabi: oddiy fe'ldan oldin, be va yordamchi fe'ldan keyin.

sentences.text: Madina speaks English, and she **also** speaks Korean.
sentences.translation: Madina inglizcha gapiradi, koreyschada **ham** gapiradi.

sentences.text: I'm a teacher, and my wife is **also** a teacher.
sentences.translation: Men o'qituvchiman, xotinim **ham** o'qituvchi.

sentences.text: We **both** live in Chilanzar, so we go to work together.
sentences.translation: **Ikkalamiz** Chilonzorda yashaymiz, shuning uchun ishga birga boramiz.

sentences.text: My sisters are **both** doctors.
sentences.translation: Opalarimning **ikkalasi ham** shifokor.

sentences.text: The guests have **all** gone home.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarning **hammasi** uyiga ketdi.

sentences.text: Tom plays football and **also** goes swimming twice a week.
sentences.translation: Tom futbol o'ynaydi, haftasiga ikki marta suzishga **ham** boradi.

sentences.text: Our children **all** love animals.
sentences.translation: Bolalarimizning **hammasi** hayvonlarni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Aziz and Bekzod were **both** at the party last night.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Bekzod **ikkalasi ham** kecha ziyofatda edi.

sentences.text: The students can **all** use the library until nine.
sentences.translation: Talabalarning **hammasi** kutubxonadan soat to'qqizgacha foydalanishi mumkin.

sentences.text: We can **also** meet on Saturday if Friday is difficult for you.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni sizga noqulay bo'lsa, shanba kuni **ham** uchrashishimiz mumkin.

examples.title: Dialogue: morning habits
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb kundalik odatlari haqida gaplashyapti: always, usually, often, never, ever — barchasi to'g'ri o'rinda.

sentences.text: — Do you **usually** get up early, Dilnoza?
sentences.translation: — Dilnoza, **odatda** erta turasizmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, I'm **always** up by six. I **often** go for a run before work.
sentences.translation: — Ha, soat oltida **doim** oyoqdaman. Ishdan oldin **tez-tez** yugurgani chiqaman.

sentences.text: — Really? I **never** run. I'm **usually** asleep at seven!
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Men **hech qachon** yugurmayman. Soat yettida **odatda** uxlab yotgan bo'laman!

sentences.text: — So what do you **usually** have in the morning?
sentences.translation: — Ertalab **odatda** nima yeysiz?

sentences.text: — Just coffee. I can **never** eat anything before ten.
sentences.translation: — Faqat qahva. Soat o'ngacha **hech qachon** hech narsa yeya olmayman.

sentences.text: — That's bad! You should **always** have a good breakfast.
sentences.translation: — Bu yomon! **Doim** yaxshilab nonushta qilish kerak.

sentences.text: — I know. My mum **often** tells me that too.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Oyim ham menga buni **tez-tez** aytadi.

sentences.text: — Do you **ever** cook in the evening?
sentences.translation: — Kechqurun **hech** ovqat pishirasizmi?

sentences.text: — **Sometimes**, but I'm **usually** too tired after work.
sentences.translation: — **Ba'zan**, lekin ishdan keyin **odatda** juda charchagan bo'laman.

sentences.text: — Then come to us on Friday — we **always** have plov on Fridays!
sentences.translation: — Unda juma kuni bizga keling — juma kunlari bizda **doim** palov bo'ladi!
